column1: # Boot smoke route for scripts/regress.py (docs/development.md, The regression harness): key <TAB> value
# The Zora's Domain save of bench.tsv: the title screen's Continue and the load prompt take the A presses at 20-32 s; on a cold start (new libraries, a busy Mac) the scene is up
# at about 50 s with its banner until about 57 s, warm at about 35 s. Link stands until 72 s, then walks and turns the camera (bench.tsv zora-pan, 17 s later) and stands from about 100 s.
# No screenshot after the walk: the frame step follows real time, so where the walk ends moves from run to run (a 33-bit dHash difference between two runs of one revision)
